title: Candy Run
html:
Quest Giver: Rose or Dorcas, believe it or not, poopiehead!

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect Yummy Yums in Candy Vaults in Mutanous Malaise

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold + 1 Kings Coins

Return to: Rose or Dorcas

Repeatable: Unknown

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect Yummy Yums Candy for the kids from the Candy Vaults of Mutanous Malaise and return them to Rose in Townston.

Offer:

Do you like candy? I like candy! I like candy a lot, a lot, a lot, and a lot! My parents don't let me eat candy, but I hide some all over the place so I can have some whenever I want! I have candy for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and dessert!

My favorite candy ever is Yummy Yums! They taste like one hundred pounds of sugar dumped into your mouth from the sky up above! I like to take a Yummy Yum candy and smush it between my fingers. Then I take that Yummy Yum and make a smushed Yummy Yum sandwich by smushing it in between two more Yummy Yums. Then I make a bunch more smushed Yummy Yum sandwiches and get all my dolls and have a smushed Yummy Yum sandwich party. You are'nt invited cuz Dungeon Runners are gross!

But now I can't have my smushed Yummy Yum sandwich parties because our parents took all the Yummy Yums and hid them because they are so good, but we found out that they are being stored in the Candy Vaults of Mutanous Malaise located in the branches off of Levels 1, 4, and 7. The Candy Vaults are located in caves, so you won't find any in the forests.

When you have all the Yummy Yums, don't forget to bring them to Rose in Townston.

Turn-in:

Wow, thanks! You are so much cooler than our parents! Ok, gotta go and eat enough candy to put me in a coma.

Objectives:

  • Yummy Yums ×50

Level range: 30–50
